errors.what: The auto-mode safety classifier returned no verdict on roughly 15 Bash calls (transient). Retrying the same command, or running read-only tools in between, got through.
The first full pytest run reported test_paper_tex failing because it raced the manuscript edit made while it ran. A rerun after the edit passed (12 of 12 on the touched tests).

doc_friction.issue: 6z's Next (g) named the AZPF as a candidate but not where to fetch its sheet. One search found two editions on distributor mirrors; recording mirror URLs in Next saves the next run a search.
pick_track.py printed a 'LAND FIRST' list. All three PRs on it were live sibling claims (one had just merged), so the list cost a read and called for no action.

deviations.why: The registered method listed a diagnostic, 'how far the AZPF sits from the rule when its index and drag are read on its own largest size'. That is identical to the held reading, so it was dropped. In its place the run reports the share of the fixed-pump size grid above size 28 and adds a post-hoc end-size sensitivity check (size 25 held), labelled as not registered.
deviations.did: reported grid share plus a labelled post-hoc check
deviations.result: the rule error moved from +0.0008 to +0.0010; disclosed in LOG, README and manuscript

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
